title: presidio-evidence: a signed-evidence substrate with canonical JSON, Ed25519 and HMAC evidence references and fail-closed verification
description: Signed-evidence substrate for the presidio-hardened-* family: canonical JSON, content addressing, Ed25519 and HMAC evidence references, provenance parents that chain records, and fail-closed verification. The contract is the JSON schemas and golden vectors; a Python package and a Rust crate both prove conformance against the same vectors. Independent of Microsoft Presidio.
